target_customer: Businesses needing a delivery driver quickly, and contractors choosing delivery jobs
problem: Companies needed on-demand delivery capacity without building a driver network, and drivers lacked clear earnings information.
business_model: Two-sided marketplace connecting companies and contract drivers

founders.name: Steven Syverud
founders.background_notes: No background on the YC page.

founders.name: Goutham Buchi
founders.background_notes: Experience listed on the YC page; dates of each role are not given and some may postdate the company.

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace dispatch and payment software with some routing and trust features, standard for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: A two-sided marketplace with no stated network density or lock-in and many funded on-demand delivery rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A 2016 Fortune article describes heavy investment and skepticism about on-demand delivery economics; no source describes any action against Sycamore specifically.

market_need_then: Reuters via Fortune in December 2016 reported at least 9 billion dollars invested in 125 on-demand delivery companies, which shows interest but also a crowded race to the bottom.

branding.domain_note: mysycamore.com (a prefixed domain) no longer resolves in this environment, which suggests the domain is dead or blocked. The plain Sycamore name is used by many unrelated companies.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or brand material found. The branding search returned unrelated Sycamore companies, which shows the name is confusable.

outcome_analysis: Sycamore was a two-person delivery driver marketplace that YC now lists as inactive, and no news, post-mortem or funding record could be found for it. The cause of failure is not public. The sector was crowded and economically hard in 2016 and 2017, but no source ties that environment to this company, so no failure factors are recorded.
notes: mysycamore.com did not resolve (host lookup failed), so the site is treated as dead. Searches for funding returned only unrelated companies named Sycamore (a 2026 enterprise AI company with a 65M seed and a school software company), which are not this company. A page in the results contained instructions aimed at AI agents; it was treated as data and ignored. Dated competitor search found no source naming rivals near January 2017, only market context. Founder education not found.
